snapshots.name: Satan
snapshots.body: Once the brightest of the archangels, now cast down into Hell after leading a failed rebellion against God. He rallies his fallen legions from the burning lake and vows to continue the war by other means.

snapshots.name: Adam
snapshots.body: The first man, formed by God and given dominion over the newly created Eden. He lives there with Eve in a state of innocence that the poem's action will put to the test.

snapshots.name: Eve
snapshots.body: The first woman, formed from Adam and his companion in Eden. Her curiosity and independence of mind are established early, well before either quality is tested.

snapshots.name: God
snapshots.body: The Almighty, creator of Heaven, Earth, and all its inhabitants, who watches the unfolding rebellion and its aftermath from his throne. He foresees the whole of the poem's events before they occur.

snapshots.name: Son
snapshots.body: The Son of God, also called the Word or the Messiah, who volunteers to undertake mankind's eventual redemption. He leads the loyal angels in the war against Satan's rebellion in Heaven.

snapshots.name: Raphael
snapshots.body: An archangel sent by God to visit Adam in Eden and warn him of the danger posed by Satan. He recounts the story of the war in Heaven and the creation of the world at Adam's request.

snapshots.name: Michael
snapshots.body: The chief commander of God's angelic armies, who leads the loyal host against Satan's rebels in the war in Heaven. He later appears to Adam with news of what is still to come.

snapshots.name: Beelzebub
snapshots.body: Satan's second-in-command among the fallen angels, seated nearest him in Hell's councils. He proposes the plan Satan himself is understood to have devised, a means of continuing the war against Heaven.

snapshots.name: Sin
snapshots.body: A monstrous figure who guards the gates of Hell, sprung fully formed from Satan's own head during the war in Heaven. Her account of her own origin reveals a family bond Satan seems eager to forget.

snapshots.name: Death
snapshots.body: A shapeless, terrible figure who stands with Sin at Hell's gates, born of her union with Satan. He challenges Satan at the threshold before either recognizes their monstrous kinship.

snapshots.name: Abdiel
snapshots.body: A seraph who alone among Satan's followers refuses to join the rebellion, arguing against Satan to his face before the war breaks out. He returns to God's camp to report what he has seen and heard.

snapshots.name: Moloch
snapshots.body: One of the fallen angels, described as the fiercest of Satan's captains in the council held in Hell. He argues for immediate open warfare against Heaven, whatever the cost.

snapshots.name: Belial
snapshots.body: One of the fallen angels, eloquent but inclined to sloth, who speaks in Hell's council after Moloch. He argues against renewing the war, preferring to endure Hell rather than risk further ruin.

snapshots.name: Mammon
snapshots.body: One of the fallen angels, associated even in Heaven with a love of wealth and craftsmanship. In Hell's council he argues for building a rival kingdom rather than warring again with God.

snapshots.name: Gabriel
snapshots.body: An archangel who commands the angelic guard set to watch over Eden. He confronts Satan directly after the intruder is discovered lurking near the sleeping Adam and Eve.
